verdict.rationale: The only event-driven capability in the evidence is a paper-publication alert ('Get notified whenever relevant papers are published'). That is a single built-in trigger with a fixed notification action, not a general system of user-defined rules and actions. Missing for 10: user-configurable rule definitions, choice of trigger events beyond new publications, actions other than notifications (e.g. running a search, updating a folder or note, calling a webhook), and any documentation or hands-on corroboration of how the alerts are configured.
